instructions.step_1: Make sure you have 20 API keys with sufficient credits configured in OPENROUTER_API_KEYS env var
instructions.step_2: Clear checkpoints and old processed files (see recommendations below)

checkpoint_clearing_strategy.RECOMMENDED: Clear checkpoints (fresh start) + clear processed_failed.csv (to allow retries to be reclassified)
commands: rm -f processed_failed.csv  (optional: keep processed_success.csv if you want to avoid re-processing successful rows)
checkpoint_clearing_strategy.why_clear_checkpoints: If a previous run crashed mid-way, stale checkpoints will cause issues. Starting fresh is safer.
checkpoint_clearing_strategy.why_clear_processed_failed: This file contains the 5,351 failed rows. Clearing it allows them to be reclassified and potentially merged into processed_success.csv on success.
checkpoint_clearing_strategy.keep_processed_success: YES — this prevents successful rows from being reclassified. The script will skip any review_id found in processed_success.csv.

api_key_handling.current: Simple round-robin rotation (batch_idx % len(api_keys)). If one key hits 402 (credits exhausted), it will still be cycled through.
api_key_handling.problem: The script does not track which keys have exhausted credits. A key with 0 balance will fail ALL batches assigned to it.
api_key_handling.suggested_improvement: Add per-key credit tracking and skip exhausted keys, or use load-balancing library.
api_key_handling.for_now: Monitor logs for 402 errors. If one key hits 402, remove it from OPENROUTER_API_KEYS and restart.
